# Nau mai, haere mai

# Welcome to the official 28th Māori Battalion website

Between 1941 and 1945, New Zealand’s 28th (Māori) Battalion forged an outstanding reputation on the battlefields of Greece, Crete, North Africa and Italy. This site is dedicated to the men who served with the Māori Battalion and to their whānau and friends. It also remembers the Māori and Pacific Island men who served in the First World War. Discover their fascinating stories of spirit and adventure, courage and camaraderie, victory and tragedy.

[Read the full story](https://28maoribattalion.org.nz/story-of-the-28th)
